title: private-deployment-apollo-weekly-sync-2026-10-12
content:
Weekly sync prep + notes (internal)

Meeting: Apollo private deployment weekly sync
Date: 2026-10-12
Time: 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees (expected): Maya Chen (RWI), Diego Alvarez (RWI), Priya Nair (RWI), Samir Patel (RWI), + Apollo infra lead (Liam), Apollo security (R. Gupta)

Purpose: quick status check on VPC/networking, certs/KMS, install progress, and any unblockers we need to escalate. Keep this light — focus on owners and next steps.

Agenda (10:00-10:30)
- 10:00 Quick status round (2 min each)
- 10:06 Network/VPC peering + firewall updates (5m)
- 10:11 Certs, KMS, and secrets management (5m)
- 10:16 Install progress / manifests / helm (5m)
- 10:21 Acceptance tests and monitoring onboarding (5m)
- 10:26 Action items, blockers, escalation (4m)

Current status summary (as of 2026-10-12):
- VPC peering: Pending — Apollo created peering request, but their infra team still needs to add the route to their private subnets (blocked by firewall rule detail). We have the peering config and routes that need to be applied (CONFLUENCE:PD-Apollo-Runbook section 2).
- VPN / Transit: Not needed per Apollo, using cloud-native peering.
- TLS certs: Apollo provided cert bundle; we discovered SAN mismatch for internal API hostname (api-internal.apollo.example). Certificate team notified — they will re-issue.
- KMS / encryption: Apollo agreed to use their KMS; we need their IAM binding for the service account. Awaiting IAM role ARN from Apollo (PRIORITY).
- Install: Partial — bootstrap cluster scripts completed; helm charts applied in staging namespace. One helm hook failing due to image pull secret (credentials rotated).
- Monitoring / logging: Datadog agent deploy is queued; we have the token but need network egress rule to datadog endpoints (blocked until peering routes + firewall updated).
- Acceptance tests: Basic smoke tests passed for core inference path, but KV cache persistence test failing intermittently.

Blockers (current):
1) Firewall / route not applied on Apollo side — prevents access to datadog endpoints and also causes peering validation to fail. Owner: Apollo infra (Liam). Impact: medium-high (blocks monitoring, observability).
2) SAN mismatch on TLS cert — blocks internal API verification and some integration tests. Owner: Apollo security (R. Gupta) + Redwood certs (Priya). Impact: high (blocks acceptance).
3) IAM binding for KMS key not granted — prevents finalizing secrets config and enabling encryption-at-rest with customer's KMS. Owner: Apollo security + Maya (follow-up). Impact: high (must be resolved before GA).
4) Image pull secret failed on helm hook — credentials rotated; need updated secret from Apollo. Owner: Samir (RWI) to request, Apollo devops to provide. Impact: low-medium (delays full install).

Open questions to raise in sync:
- Can Apollo expedite the firewall/route change this week? If not, propose a fallback (temporary public egress with restricted CIDRs) — is that acceptable to their security?
- Who is the single point of contact for IAM/KMS role confirmation? Need ARN + exact principal format we should expect.
- Certificate re-issuance ETA? We should confirm certs will have api-internal.apollo.example in SAN and include any ALIAS hostnames.

Planned talking points / script (for Maya):
- Start with quick wins: smoke tests passed for inference path + helm chart applied in staging.
- Call out high-impact blockers (KMS ARN and cert SAN) and ask for concrete owners and EOD/48h ETA.
- Ask Apollo for permission to open temporary egress for datadog if peer routes cannot be applied quickly (present secure mitigations).
- Confirm next sync cadence (keep weekly unless blockers persist).

Action items (owner / due):
- Apollo infra (Liam): Apply route + firewall rule to allow peering and egress to datadog IPs. Due: 2026-10-14. (Linked: JIRA PDAP-312)
- Apollo security (R. Gupta): Re-issue TLS certs with SAN api-internal.apollo.example and confirm availability in PKI. Due: 2026-10-13. (Linked: CONFLUENCE:PD-Apollo-Runbook)
- Apollo security / infra: Provide KMS key ARN + example IAM binding for Redwood service principal. Due: 2026-10-14. (Linked: JIRA PDAP-298)
- Samir Patel (RWI): Send image pull secret request + help verify correct secret format. Due: 2026-10-12 EOD.
- Priya Nair (RWI): Coordinate cert re-issue with Redwood certs team and validate cert chain once provided. Due: 2026-10-13.
- Maya Chen (RWI): Draft escalation note for account exec if KMS / cert not resolved by EOD 2026-10-14. Due: 2026-10-15.
- Diego Alvarez (RWI): Prepare a short fallback plan doc for temporary egress (security mitigations and minimal CIDR list). Due: 2026-10-13.

Notes / quick troubleshooting steps (for follow-up):
- Verification commands: we should run 'kubectl get secrets -n redwood' and 'kubectl describe pod <init-pod>' to confirm image pull secret failure. Samir to run and paste logs in slack thread.
- For cert validation: use openssl s_client -connect api-internal.apollo.example:443 -showcerts and verify SAN list. Priya will validate.
- KMS test: once IAM binding provided, run a test encrypt/decrypt using the customer's key in a staging namespace (Maya + Samir).

Risks to surface to Account Exec if unresolved by next week:
- Unable to complete acceptance test gating for GA (KMS + cert) -> delays go/no-go
- Observability blindspots (no datadog) -> risk during early traffic soak

Next sync / follow-up:
- Keep weekly cadence; propose ad-hoc meeting if any high-priority blocker not resolved by due dates above.

Notes to self (Maya):
- Bring up potential of offering a short-term managed egress path (we can host a small proxy) — be ready with cost/ops impact if Apollo asks for an internal option.
- Keep draft escalation note minimal: facts, dates, next steps, ask for exec intervention only if no ETA from Apollo on KMS/cert by 10/14.

References:
- CONFLUENCE:PD-Apollo-Runbook (networking, install steps)
- JIRA PDAP-312 (networking / peering)
- JIRA PDAP-298 (KMS onboarding)
- GH redwood/apollo-deploy#142 (helm chart fix for imagePullSecrets)
- Slack #apollo-deploy-thread (ongoing logs and screenshots)

End of notes.

(Will paste cleaned agenda into calendar invite and ping Liam + R. Gupta before the meeting.)
